latestVersion.changelog:
**Major simplification and privacy-first redesign. Now focused entirely on user-driven, local memory capture.**

- Removed all code and source integrations; the skill no longer accesses or processes external data or chats.
- Profiles are now built exclusively from the user's own memories, descriptions, and voluntary input.
- All data is stored locally in plain text — no cloud features, no data transmission, no scraping.
- Profile structure and interaction modes are clarified, with emphasis on privacy, consent, and user agency.
- Changelog: Large documentation rewrite for clarity, privacy, and ethical use; all integrations and dependencies removed.
